name: Task_7
description: Measure the 300 K reference volume for the aluminum expansion study. Build a periodic 108-atom aluminum cell by repeating a conventional cubic FCC cell with lattice parameter 4.05 Å 3 x 3 x 3, and use the supplied MACE-MP-0 model. Initialize velocities once with a recorded random seed, remove center-of-mass momentum, and run isotropic NPT at 300 K and 1.01325 bar. Choose suitable numerical settings, equilibration time, production time, and sampling. Report the mean measured temperature, pressure, and volume from the production data. Save the thermal trace, production trajectory, and restartable final state so the heating sequence can continue without resetting positions or velocities.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in the required fields for this task. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
